# Video fixtures

These small fixtures come from [Web Platform Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) at commit `8b8c0d24b1b6510f040122509e3504f377ee0678`. The upstream BSD license is included in `LICENSE.md`.

- `video.mp4`: upstream `media/movie_5.mp4`, a five-second clip for decoding, seeking, and range tests.
- `video.webm`: upstream `media/white.webm`, for WebM detection and playback.

They are test inputs only and are not included in application images or frontend bundles.
